policy: Append-only across phases. Open items are honest limits, never hidden failures.

items.title: DomainDispatch trait ownership moved to care-orchestrator
items.detail: The Part A dispatch trait was first drafted in the service crate; the proof tests needed it without a service dependency, so it was moved into crates/care-orchestrator (engine.rs) and re-exported. Service code and tests now share one trait shape.

items.title: No committed model artifact in this delivery
items.detail: Per the model-selection contract, no GGUF binary was fabricated. DeterministicFallbackReasoner is the default enabled engine; the LLM path is fully coded behind --features local-model with documented manual activation (assets/models/models.manifest.json activationContract).

items.title: Audit allowlist regex initially caught Cargo.toml section keys
items.detail: The dependency allowlist gate matched [package] keys (name/edition/publish) as dependencies. Fixed by parsing only [dependencies]/[dev-dependencies] sections; llama_cpp_2 waiver check now applies to real declarations, not comment mentions.
